title: Ethren Writing Studio Master Story Bible
description: Master story bible synced from the Writer repository. The browser merges matching master entries into the local working Bible while keeping local-only entries.

characters.name: Ethren Hollowmere
characters.appearance: Gray eyes; messy black hair. Later planning gives him duller gray eyes and dark circles after the Hollowmere massacre.
characters.personality: Observant; tends to stare without blinking; serious when focused; determined and stubborn. After the massacre he becomes more suspicious, unstable, and revenge-driven.
characters.relationships: Son of Alaric and Evelyn Hollowmere; younger brother of Lucan. Formally betrothed to Celestine Rosenthal. Cassiel is his closest friend/foil.
characters.power: Time-based Vestige/Tablet concept. Later working name: Tablet/Vestige of Inevitability. Rank 0 ideas include slowing through touch and extreme time perception. A time-themed Herald is planned.
characters.secrets: Plans include hiding his true power from academy staff with Cassiel. The watch from early chapters is intended to become guidance from a future version of Ethren.
characters.arc: Hollowmere heir → massacre survivor → mercenary gap → academy → revenge. He struggles with trust and eventually with love/attachment.
characters.knowledge: Knows his family, the arranged engagement, early Vestige basics, and what he personally witnesses. Do not let him know future reveals before he earns them.
characters.notes: Native to the world; reincarnation idea was scrapped.

characters.name: Cassiel Veyr
characters.personality: Justice-driven, clever, and capable of manipulation. His arc comes from being neglected/overshadowed by a sibling.
characters.relationships: Close friend/foil to Ethren. His family expected a Flame power; a sister possesses a Flame tablet/vestige.
characters.power: Space-based Vestige/Tablet. Ethren and Cassiel plan to conceal the true nature of their powers at the academy.
characters.secrets: His power is much rarer than his family expected.
characters.arc: Neglected child → capable partner to Ethren → justice/identity arc.
characters.knowledge: Should only know Ethren's secrets that Ethren has actually shared with him.
characters.notes: Name changed from Cassian to Cassiel.

characters.name: Celestine Rosenthal
characters.personality: Current draft presents her as distant/indifferent toward Ethren. Earlier planning frames her as publicly polished but emotionally disloyal.
characters.relationships: Daughter of Marquis Severin Rosenthal. Formally betrothed to Ethren. Closely associated with Leandor/Leander and later intended to be his romantic interest.
characters.power: Earlier bible idea: Silver Frost / Ice. Treat as planned until explicitly shown in the draft.
characters.secrets: Planned cheating/betrayal reveal with the duke's son / Leandor.
characters.arc: Arranged fiancée → betrayal reveal → part of Ethren's academy revenge/social conflict.
characters.knowledge: Knows the engagement and her own social circle; she is intended to be unaware of Ethren's later notoriety when he arrives at the academy.
characters.notes: House Rosenthal proposed the engagement for political/economic stability.

characters.name: Mirelle Arden
characters.appearance: Brunette hair worn in a neat bun; calm, measuring presence in the current draft.
characters.relationships: Part of Celestine's social circle in Chapter 7. Planned to grow closer to Ethren during the first portal/survival scenario.
characters.power: Earlier bible idea: Sacred Spring / Water-Healing. Treat as planned until shown.
characters.arc: Social-circle member → portal teammate → closer connection to Ethren.
characters.knowledge: Only what she has personally observed or been told.
characters.notes: Do not force romance too quickly.

characters.name: Crown Prince Evander
characters.personality: Confident, competitive, and willing to provoke Leandor.
characters.relationships: Crown Prince; rival to Leandor Valemont.
characters.power: Principle of Fear. Chapter 7 ends with Leandor realizing the sensation Evander caused is fear.
characters.secrets: The exact mechanics/limits of Fear should remain controlled until explained.
characters.arc: Early high-level benchmark and recurring royal figure.
characters.knowledge: Royal/noble knowledge appropriate to his position; do not grant him private Hollowmere secrets without a reason.

characters.name: Leandor Valemont
characters.relationships: Son of Derick Valemont. Rival to Crown Prince Evander. Closely associated with Celestine.
characters.power: A yellow/golden crystal Vestige appears in Chapter 7 and forms a hard translucent barrier. Exact Principle name is not yet locked in the current draft.
characters.arc: Promising noble → academy/social rival → portal teammate in planning.
characters.knowledge: Noble and personal knowledge only; track what Celestine tells him.
characters.notes: Continuity checker should flag Leandor vs Leander spelling drift.

characters.name: Lucan Hollowmere
characters.personality: Teasing but genuinely concerned for Ethren.
characters.relationships: Older brother of Ethren; son of Alaric and Evelyn.
characters.arc: Family anchor in Ethren's early life.
characters.knowledge: Knows family/social information appropriate to his scenes.
characters.notes: His teasing should still show underlying care.

characters.name: Alaric Hollowmere
characters.personality: Controlled, disciplined, patient, protective beneath a restrained exterior.
characters.relationships: Husband of Evelyn; father of Lucan and Ethren.
characters.power: Possesses a Vestige but refuses to reveal it to young Ethren in the current draft.
characters.secrets: His Vestige/power and what he knows about Ethren's unusual signs remain concealed.
characters.arc: Mentor/father figure whose loss is central to Ethren's planned revenge arc.
characters.knowledge: Knows more about Vestiges and noble affairs than Ethren.

characters.name: Evelyn Hollowmere
characters.personality: Protective and openly concerned for Ethren.
characters.relationships: Wife of Alaric; mother of Lucan and Ethren.
characters.arc: Family anchor before the planned massacre.
characters.knowledge: Family and noble-house knowledge appropriate to her role.

characters.name: Seraphina Veyr
characters.relationships: Appears in Celestine's circle in Chapter 7. Earlier planning connects a Veyr sister with Flame; confirm exact sibling relationship before locking it.
characters.power: Earlier bible idea: Flame / Crowned Inferno. Treat as planned until shown.
characters.notes: Verify relation to Cassiel before publishing as canon.

characters.name: Rowan Thane
characters.relationships: Appears in Celestine's circle in Chapter 7.
characters.power: Earlier bible idea: Earth/defense / Unbroken Bastion. Treat as planned until shown.

characters.name: Derick Valemont
characters.appearance: Current draft introduces him at the Valemont training ground; clothing is somewhat wrinkled.
characters.notes: Judges Evander vs Leandor in Chapter 7.

characters.name: Severin Rosenthal
characters.personality: Politically minded from the engagement letter.

characters.name: Hedric Alops
characters.notes: Introduced greeting Alaric at the gate in planning/draft scenes.

vestiges.name: Vestige Basics
vestiges.details: A Vestige gives its bearer power over a Principle. Vestiges usually appear as floating crystals; color, markings, rings and surrounding effects vary by Principle and bearer.

vestiges.name: Ethren — Time / Inevitability
vestiges.details: Ethren's power is time-based. Later working concept is a rare inevitability/time variant. Rank-0 ideas: slowing by touch and extreme time perception. He may manifest a time-themed Herald.

vestiges.name: Cassiel — Space
vestiges.details: Rare Space-based Vestige/Tablet; hidden from academy staff in planning.

vestiges.name: Evander — Fear
vestiges.details: Principle of Fear; demonstrated against Leandor in Chapter 7.

vestiges.name: Leandor — Barrier Vestige
vestiges.details: Yellow/golden crystal with runes and translucent icy-looking layer; creates a hard translucent barrier.

vestiges.name: Mirelle — Water/Healing
vestiges.details: Sacred Spring / Water-Healing concept; confirm in prose before treating as revealed canon.

vestiges.name: Celestine — Ice
vestiges.details: Silver Frost / Ice concept; confirm in prose before treating as revealed canon.

vestiges.name: Alaric — Concealed
vestiges.details: Alaric has a Vestige but refuses to reveal it to young Ethren.

principles.name: Time
principles.details: Ethren's original/core concept. Includes time slowing and extreme perception ideas.

principles.name: Inevitability / Finality
principles.details: Possible evolved name for Ethren's rare time variant. Finality was considered as an alternative name.

principles.name: Bone / Remains
principles.details: Ethren is intended to gain a Bone/Remains-type Principle during the other-dimension/future-self mentor arc.

principles.name: Parasite
principles.details: A Principle concept the author liked; not assigned as canon yet.

principles.name: Manifestations
principles.details: Manifestations are individualized ways of expressing a Principle. Dimensions can contain learnable Manifestations, but each bearer may manifest them differently.

dimensions.name: Dimension System
dimensions.details: Dimensions/portals are rank-based and support the academy story rather than replacing it. Rank advancement and objectives/materials are tied to higher-rank Dimensions in planning.

dimensions.name: First Portal Team
dimensions.details: Seven-person team concept: Ethren, Cassiel, Celestine, Leandor, Seraphina, Mirelle, Rowan.

dimensions.name: The City Without Shadows
dimensions.details: Earlier concept with seven seals, stopped clocks, moving shadows, folded space and Hollowmere clues. Keep as an option unless superseded.

dimensions.name: Historical Portal Concepts
dimensions.details: Roman Empire / Rome vs Carthage and other history-based scenarios were considered. Survival arc should stay relatively short.

dimensions.name: Future-Ethren Dimension
dimensions.details: Desolate forest, Gothic buildings/cathedral, and a mentor who is actually a future bad-timeline version of Ethren. Ethren gains Bone/Remains-related power somehow during this arc.

locations.name: Hollowmere Manor
locations.details: Three-story dark-gray stone noble estate, smaller than a duke's estate. Courtyard, training ground, veranda, dining room and Alaric's office are established.

locations.name: Valemont Estate / Training Ground
locations.details: Location of the social gathering/banquet arc and Evander vs Leandor duel. Valemont family knights/guards are present.

locations.name: Academy
locations.details: All students are power users. Entrance tournament/FFA concept; top ten enter a council. Academy arc is central; Dimensions are supporting arcs.

locations.name: Gothic Cathedral Dimension
locations.details: Part of the desolate other-dimension where Ethren encounters his future-self mentor.

locations.name: The City Without Shadows
locations.details: Possible portal city with stopped clocks, moving shadows and folded space.

nobility.name: House Hollowmere
nobility.details: Alaric is Count of Hollowmere. Family: Alaric, Evelyn, Lucan, Ethren.

nobility.name: House Rosenthal
nobility.details: Severin Rosenthal is a Marquis and head of the house. Celestine is his daughter. Proposed marriage to House Hollowmere for stability/prosperity.

nobility.name: House Valemont
nobility.details: Leandor and his father Derick belong to House Valemont. Earlier planning frames Leandor as a duke's son; verify Derick's exact title in final canon.

timeline.name: Age 6 — training begins
timeline.details: Ethren insists on sword training, trains with Alaric, experiences the backward-clock/faceless-creature vision and learns basic Vestige information.

timeline.name: Rosenthal arrangement
timeline.details: House Rosenthal proposes a formal betrothal between Celestine and Ethren.

timeline.name: Valemont gathering / duel
timeline.details: Ethren attends the Valemont gathering; Evander challenges Leandor. Leandor manifests a barrier Vestige; Evander's Fear Principle is revealed.

timeline.name: Hollowmere massacre
timeline.details: House Hollowmere is destroyed; Ethren becomes suspicious, unstable and revenge-driven.

timeline.name: Three-year gap
timeline.details: Ethren spends part of the gap with a mercenary group. His parents had prepared funds/contact for academy entry around age 14.

timeline.name: Academy entry
timeline.details: Ethren enters around age 13–14. Entrance tournament and council/top-ten ideas. Ethren and Cassiel conceal their true powers.

timeline.name: Cheating reveal
timeline.details: Ethren sees Celestine with the duke's son/Leandor holding hands; she is initially unaware of his later identity/notoriety.

timeline.name: First portal
timeline.details: A seven-person team including Ethren/Cassiel/Celestine/Leandor/Seraphina/Mirelle/Rowan. Portal should advance relationships without becoming too long.

timeline.name: Future-Ethren arc
timeline.details: Other dimension, Gothic cathedral, future bad-timeline Ethren as mentor, Bone/Remains power gain.

relationships.name: Ethren ↔ Cassiel
relationships.details: Friends/foils. Ethren is revenge-driven; Cassiel carries a justice/neglect arc. They cooperate to hide their rare powers.

relationships.name: Ethren ↔ Celestine
relationships.details: Political engagement. Celestine is distant; planned cheating/betrayal becomes a major emotional/social conflict.

relationships.name: Celestine ↔ Leandor
relationships.details: Closely associated in the current draft; intended love-interest/cheating connection.

relationships.name: Ethren ↔ Mirelle
relationships.details: Planned to become closer during the first portal/survival scenario. Do not rush the bond.

relationships.name: Evander ↔ Leandor
relationships.details: Competitive noble/royal rivalry, shown directly in Chapter 7.

relationships.name: Ethren ↔ Alaric
relationships.details: Ethren wants to prove himself; Alaric teaches discipline and restraint.

relationships.name: Ethren ↔ Lucan
relationships.details: Lucan teases Ethren but shows genuine concern.

mysteries.name: The watch
mysteries.details: Early watch is intended to become a guidance device from a future version of Ethren.

mysteries.name: Backward clock vision
mysteries.details: Ethren sees an enormous backward-turning clock, a faceless marked creature and smaller clocks.

mysteries.name: Alaric's Vestige
mysteries.details: Alaric refuses to reveal his Vestige to young Ethren.

mysteries.name: Hollowmere massacre
mysteries.details: Who caused it, why, and what larger conflict it connects to should be tracked.

mysteries.name: Dead gods / higher beings
mysteries.details: The setting has 'gods are dead' lore and powerful antagonistic beings in a deadlock. Exact cosmology still needs locking.

mysteries.name: Future mentor identity
mysteries.details: The Gothic-dimension mentor is actually a future bad-timeline version of Ethren.

foreshadowing.name: Watch → future Ethren
foreshadowing.details: Seed subtle usefulness/oddity before the future-self reveal. Avoid explaining it too early.

foreshadowing.name: Clock vision → Ethren's power
foreshadowing.details: Backward clock/faceless creature foreshadows Ethren's unusual time-related Vestige and larger fate.

foreshadowing.name: Fear reveal
foreshadowing.details: Physical symptoms culminate in the single-word realization: Fear.

foreshadowing.name: Concealed true powers
foreshadowing.details: Ethren and Cassiel intend to hide their actual powers from academy staff.

foreshadowing.name: Future-Ethren mentor
foreshadowing.details: Seed echoes of Ethren's habits, phrasing or time motifs without making identity obvious.

knowledge.name: Ethren
knowledge.details: Knows only what he has witnessed/told. He should not know future-self, massacre culprit, Celestine betrayal or academy secrets before their reveals.

knowledge.name: Cassiel
knowledge.details: Can know his own Space power and whatever Ethren shares; do not automatically give him Ethren's hidden future information.

knowledge.name: Celestine
knowledge.details: Knows engagement and her own circle. Planned to be unaware of Ethren's later academy notoriety/identity until the intended reveal.

knowledge.name: Mirelle
knowledge.details: Calm observer; only knows what she sees/hears.

knowledge.name: Evander
knowledge.details: Royal knowledge does not equal omniscience; private Hollowmere facts still need a source.

knowledge.name: Leandor
knowledge.details: Track what Celestine and Valemont family tell him; avoid accidental knowledge of Ethren's hidden rare power.

canonMemory.name: Core style rule
canonMemory.details: Preserve direct web-novel prose, short paragraphs, simple clarity, effective dramatic fragments, occasional tiny POV shifts, and single-quoted direct thoughts. Give advice before rewriting.

canonMemory.name: Naming rule
canonMemory.details: Evelyn spelling is fixed. Cassiel replaced Cassian. Current draft uses Leandor; older notes may say Leander, so flag inconsistency instead of silently changing canon.

canonMemory.name: Reincarnation
canonMemory.details: Ethren is native to the world. Do not introduce reincarnation.

canonMemory.name: Academy vs Dimensions
canonMemory.details: Academy is the core arc; Dimensions support it. Avoid letting portal survival arcs drag too long.
